hero.title: Is Intuit Enterprise Suite an ERP?
hero.lede: The short answer, the details, and the questions finance leaders ask most before they switch.
answer.title: Yes, an AI-native ERP for growing companies
answer.body: Intuit Enterprise Suite is a unified platform that goes beyond basic accounting, consolidating finances, payroll, payments, workforce, and marketing into one connected system, with AI-driven insights and robust multi-entity management.
tabs.title: What makes it different
item-1.title: One connected system, not five tools
item-1.body: Consolidates finances, payroll, payments, workforce, and marketing into one platform, reducing manual data entry and cost.
item-2.title: Automation and intelligence built in
item-2.body: AI provides proactive automation and insights across accounting, financial planning, and more, so the team moves away from manual workflows.
item-3.title: Built for multiple entities and subsidiaries
item-3.body: Manage intercompany transactions and generate consolidated reports with a comprehensive view of performance across the business.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
item-4.question: What size company is it built for?
item-4.answer: Intuit Enterprise Suite is built for businesses with growing financial complexity, especially those managing multiple entities, locations, or projects, that have outgrown QuickBooks Online but are not ready for a traditional ERP.
item-5.question: Is this a cloud version of QuickBooks Desktop?
item-5.answer: No. It is a new category of software distinct from QuickBooks Online and Desktop, built for businesses that have outgrown basic accounting and need to scale operations.
item-6.question: How easy is it to migrate?
item-6.answer: Whether you migrate from QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, or a non-Intuit solution, a Professional Services team scopes and moves your data and a Customer Success Manager runs guided onboarding.
item-7.question: Is support available?
item-7.answer: Yes. Core product support is available Monday through Friday, 6 AM to 6 PM PT, and a dedicated Customer Success Manager is assigned to your account during onboarding.
cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.body: Talk to a migration specialist and find out if Intuit Enterprise Suite is the right move for your business.
